description: Read a watch list of contacts and return only what changed since the last run: who left, who landed where, who replaced them, and who started after a role closed. Each row carries evidence, a source date, a segment, a first line draft, and Slack, HubSpot, HeyReach, and Instantly payloads. Pass people (required) and, optionally, replies, bounces, posting changes, suppression, and your own provider keys in providerKeys; it never fetches LinkedIn and holds no key of its own. State is kept per watch_list_id. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

bounces.description: Optional bounces: work_email, bounce_type, smtp_code, smtp_text, bounced_at.

features.description: Switches: replacement, closed_posting, contact_data, first_line, icp, include_promotions. Defaults on except include_promotions.

first_run_mode.description: report: the first run returns every change it finds. baseline: the first run stores state and returns nothing, charging only contact_checked.

icp_tiers.description: Optional map of company domain to tier, shown on landed rows. Never blocks a row.

linkedin_reader_dataset_id.description: Optional: the dataset id of a Proofed LinkedIn reader run on the same Apify account. Rows join to people by profile URL.

max_people_per_run.description: A list longer than this fails the run before any read or charge. Default 150, at most 1,000.

max_replacement_candidates.description: Candidates proposed per leaver. A person confirms each.

max_spend_usd.description: Stops the run before a charge that would cross it.

people.description: Your watch list, one object per person: person_name, profile_url (optional), company_domain, company_name, title, work_email, relationship (prospect, mgl, deal_contact, customer_champion), external_id, crm_id, deal_id, known_history (a HeyReach copy, a Proofed LinkedIn reader row, or generic roles), last_reading (with state_source caller). The engine reads only these people. At most max_people_per_run per run.

posting_changes.description: Optional Account Hiring Watch rows. A closed posting starts a new hire search at that company.

providerKeys.description: Your own keys: serper or serpapi (web search), prospeo, bounceban (verifier), findymail, exa. Never written to state, output, logs, or the webhook. Your own key, sent as a run input; never stored by the actor.

read_mode.description: stored_first: your known_history first, then your keys. live_only: ignore known_history. stored_only: only known_history, no key calls.

replies.description: Optional reply texts: external_id or work_email or profile_url, text, received_at, channel, is_auto_reply. Text is classified and dropped; only its sha1 is kept.

sender_context.description: Optional topic phrase for the first line draft, for example: content production at scale.

state_source.description: actor: the engine keeps state between runs in a named store. caller: you send last_reading per person and keep state yourself.

suppression.description: emails, profile_urls, opted_out_emails, opted_out_profile_urls, company_domains, company_names. Suppressed people are dropped before the read and cost nothing.

sweep_interval_days.description: With state_source actor, a person read within this many days is skipped.

watch_list_id.description: Names the list. State is kept per watch list id when state_source is actor.

webhook_secret.description: Signing secret; a whsec_ value is base64 decoded. Your own key, sent as a run input; never stored by the actor.

webhook_url.description: Optional: signed Standard Webhooks POST of up to 100 signal rows per request.
